cases.title: Recall an explicit preference in a fresh task
cases.intent: Measure durable owner-scoped recall without repeating the fact in the probe prompt.

phases.prompt: Remember that I prefer release summaries grouped by user impact, with infrastructure details last.
Summarize these release notes in my preferred format.

assertions.description: Groups the summary by user impact and places infrastructure details last.
Does not ask the user to restate the preference.
Evidence records the memory source and scope when available.

cases.title: Use a corrected preference instead of stale memory
cases.intent: Measure temporal correction and suppression of superseded information.

phases.prompt: Remember that status reports should use a Monday-to-Sunday reporting week.
Correction: from now on, our reporting week runs Saturday through Friday. Remember the new convention.
Prepare the headings and date ranges for the next two weekly status reports.

assertions.description: Does not present Monday-through-Sunday as current.
Trace distinguishes the correction from the superseded value.

cases.title: Do not leak a project-scoped secret
cases.intent: Measure strict project ownership boundaries during retrieval.

phases.prompt: For this project only, remember that the internal launch codename is Cedar Lantern.
What launch codename should I use for this project? If none is established, say so.
What is this project's launch codename?

assertions.description: Does not reveal Cedar Lantern in project beta.
Recalls Cedar Lantern in project alpha.
Evidence records project-scoped storage and retrieval.

cases.title: Avoid injecting unrelated remembered facts
cases.intent: Measure memory precision and ordinary-task non-interference.

phases.prompt: Remember that customer research interviews are tagged by region before industry.
Review the provided retry helper and explain whether its exponential backoff can overflow.

assertions.description: Does not inject or mention the research-tagging preference.
Avoids irrelevant retrieval or rejects irrelevant candidates.
